description: Deterministic evidence for the exact variables used to form each retained frozen cluster model.

profiles.profile_name: Motivation profile 1: externally or uncertainly motivated, with moderate study support
Motivation profile 2: goal-aligned motivation with mixed study confidence and support
Motivation profile 3: highly self-directed, capable and connected

cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: Why are you studying right now? Which best describes your motivation?

answer_distribution.answer: External: qualification required for a job
Amotivated/uncertain: following the path ended up on

Introjected: avoid guilt or disappointing family
